summary: Instance groups can be created by a system administrator with POST /api/v2/instance_groups and instances added with POST /api/v2/instance_groups/<id>/instances/ {'id': <instance_id>}; added instances start listening on the group's work queue.
questions: How do I create an instance group with the API?
How do I add an instance to an instance group via the REST API?
Who can create instance groups through the API?

answer_card.title: Manage instance groups with the API
answer_card.answer_md:
As a system administrator:

- Create: `POST /api/v2/instance_groups/` with the group's fields
- Add an instance: `POST /api/v2/instance_groups/<group_id>/instances/` with body `{"id": <instance_id>}`

The instance then starts listening on that group's work queue.
